title: Diet Plan Performance
summary: A dieter records daily calorie intake.
statement: A dieter records daily calorie intake. For each sequence of k consecutive days, if the total calories are below a lower threshold, the dieter loses a point. If the total calories exceed an upper threshold, the dieter gains a point. Otherwise, no change. The dieter starts with zero points and the total points after n days are returned.
constraints: Every contiguous k-day window contributes independently.
Below lower loses one; above upper gains one.
hints: Maintain the sum of the current k-day window.
Score the first window, then slide by adding the entering and subtracting the leaving day.
Compare each sum strictly with lower and upper.
Every k-day interval is visited once with its exact sum.
editorial: Every k-day interval is visited once with its exact sum.

tests.explanation: Two days are below, two above, and one equal, totaling zero.
The only window exceeds upper, earning one point.
